---
title: "08 - Regularization and Trees"
format:
  html:
    toc-expand: 4
---

Learning objectives for this week:

- Understand the concepts of overfitting and underfitting and how this reflects a variance-bias tradeoff
- Understand and perform cross-validation to evaluate model performance.
- Understand the idea of regularization and apply L1, L2 and Elastic Net regularization to linear models.
- Perform hyperparameter tuning with techniques such as Grid Search and Random Search
- Build and interpret decision tree models.
